description: This Java source file implements an immutable class 'ModifyFeatureLiveCommandImpl' which is a part of a command pattern within a signals/commands framework. It encapsulates the logic for modifying a feature in a live context, providing methods to access feature details, create modified command instances, and generate responses.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the ModifyFeatureLiveCommand, providing functionalities to manage and process live modification commands for features.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of ModifyFeatureLiveCommandImpl from a generic Command object, casting it to ModifyFeature.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the feature associated with this command.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns the Feature object associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new command instance with the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization; always returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new AnswerBuilder for this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including class name and superclass details.
